author: Michael Larabel
description: The many SoC patches have landed within the Linux 7.4 kernel providing support for dozens of new boards as well as a number of new SoCs like the Apple M4 and the A18 Pro as found in the MacBook Neo. The Google Tensor 5 was also finally mainlined along with Pixel 10 devices. Plus some unreleased Qualcomm SoC support rounds out the bunch...
title: Initial Support For The Apple M4 & Apple A18 Pro Make It Into Linux 7.4

author: Michael Larabel
description: The mainline Linux 7.4 kernel will be capable of running  on the Steam Frame VR headset...
title: Steam Frame VR Headset Sees Mainline Support With Linux 7.4

author: Michael Larabel
description: The Compute Express Link (CXL) subsystem changes were merged today for the Linux 7.4 kernel. The fun work this cycle is preparing to support Dynamic Capacity Devices...
title: Linux 7.4 Preps CXL For Very Neat Dynamic Capacity Devices "DCD"

author: Michael Larabel
description: KMSCON as the user-space terminal emulator targeting Linux DRM/KMS interfaces as an alternative to the in-kernel VT now is able to individually configure monitors in multi-monitor setups. Plus a variety of other improvements with today's KMSCON 10.1 release...
title: KMSCON 10.1 Released With Support For Per-Monitor Configurations

author: Michael Larabel
description: Open-source developer Jason Donenfeld known for his work on WireGuard announced today the release of kwin-type. KWin-type is a new Wayland-compatible program for auto-typing text from the standard input under the KWin Wayland compositor...
title: KWin-Type Introduced To Address KDE Wayland Usability Gap For Auto-Typing Text

author: Michael Larabel
description: In development for a number of months now has been Kraid as a modern graphics compiler for recent Arm Mali GPUs. Kraid was merged for Mesa 26.2 back in June while in Mesa 27.0 due out in Q1 it will be switching to this new shader compiler by default...
title: Mesa 27.0 Switching To Kraid Compiler By Default For Arm Mali GPUs

author: Michael Larabel
description: For those curious about the Snapdragon X1 Elite performance on the recently released Ubuntu 26.10 Concept X1E ISO, here are some benchmarks showing the performance relative to Ubuntu 26.04 LTS X1E state on the same hardware.
title: Snapdragon X1 Elite / Acer Swift 14 AI Performance On The Ubuntu 26.10 X1E Concept

author: Michael Larabel
description: The EFI updates have been merged for the Linux 7.4 kernel and include an improvement for when the system was booted directly into the kernel on EFI-based systems without using a bootloader like GRUB or systemd-boot...
title: Linux 7.4 EFI Brings Improvement For Helping Systemd When Kernel Booted Directly

author: Michael Larabel
description: Nouveau-DKMS is in development as an out-of-tree spin-off of the open-source NVIDIA "Nouveau" driver focused on providing better support for NVIDIA GeForce 400/500 "Fermi" series graphics processors and potentially other generations too pre-Turing where the modern Nova driver is in development by NVIDIA...
title: Nouveau-DKMS Aims For Better NVIDIA Open-Source Experience On Old GPUs

author: Michael Larabel
description: Merged for Linux 7.4 Git and marked for back-porting to Linux 7.2/7.3 stable is a regression fix affecting at least the AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 "Strix Point" laptop SoC when making use of Cache Aware Scheduling...
title: Linux Fixes AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 Regression Due To Cache Aware Scheduling

author: Michael Larabel
description: Open-source developer Mark Harmstone who is known for his work on developing a Btrfs file-system driver for Windows has spent the past few years working on a new hobby operating system. Moxnox is an HT-like, POSIX-compatible operating system...
title: Moxnox: NT-Like, POSIX-Compatible Hobby OS Running Atop Btrfs

author: Michael Larabel
description: The EXT4 file-system changes were merged Sunday night for the ongoing Linux 7.4 merge window. The headline feature of EXT4 in this new kernel version is opt-in support for buffered IOmap usage that can lead to "significant" performance improvements for large writes...
title: EXT4 Lands Optional Buffered IOmap For Significant Performance Win With Large Writes
